Except for Competitive Bidding, Limited Source Bidding, Competitive Dialogue, and Unsolicited Offer with Bid Matching, the BAC may delegate the conduct of procurement activities for the other modes of procurement to the End-User or Implementing Unit, or the Procurement Unit of the Procuring Entity.

items.label: Purchase Request/Terms of Reference
items.details: Purchase Request (PR) for Goods only, Terms of Reference, Scope of Work or Job Order Request

items.label: Proof of CSE Unavailability
items.details:
For CSE: Proof that CSEs are unavailable in PS-DBM (Section 40)
Certificate of Non-Availability of Stocks - Due to zero inventory in PS-DBM: secure a Certificate of Non-Availability of Stocks by downloading from the PhilGEPS Electronic Catalogue
List of CSE from PhilGEPS Electronic Catalogue - Technical specifications are not sufficient to meet the specific needs and requirements - secure a complete list of technical specifications of all CSE items by downloading from the PhilGEPS Electronic Catalogue
Stock Position Report from the PhilGEPS Electronic Catalogue - Available but not sufficient to meet the required quantity - generate and download the current Stock Position Report from the PhilGEPS Electronic Catalogue showing the available stock at the specific time and date of access
BAC Resolution upon recommendation of the End-User - Reasons of efficiency, practicality, or economic viability – secure BAC Resolution upon recommendation of the End-User. The End-User or Implementing Unit shall submit its written recommendation to the BAC identifying the specific reason and providing justifications thereof.

items.label: Authority from HoPE
items.details: Authorizing the End-User or Implementing Unit to directly purchase from any known and reputable source with legal, technical, and financial capacity based on requirements under Section 32.3

items.label: BIR Compliant Invoice
items.details: BIR Compliant Invoice showing the quantity, description of the articles, unit and total value, duly signed by the dealer or his representative and indicating receipt by Property/ Supply Unit of the items delivered. Date of actual delivery should be indicated. Additional secondary document like Official Receipt or Acknowledgement Receipt as proof of payment may be requested depending on the type of transaction.

items.label: Acceptance and Inspection Report
items.details: Acceptance and Inspection Report prepared by the Property and Supply Unit.

items.label: Completion and Acceptance Report
items.details: If there is no Acceptance and Inspection Report (AIR): the Completion and Acceptance Report (CAR).

items.label: Requisition and Issue Slip
items.details: Prepared by requisitioning unit/end-user unit (if no ICS and/or PAR only; not required for petty cash transactions)

items.label: Inventory Custodian Slip
items.details: Inventory and property items below fifty thousand pesos (P 50,000.00) with pictures. Note: ICS of Low-valued Items (P5,000 and below) should be separated from High-valued Items (above P5000-P49,999.99). Please indicate serial numbers.

items.label: Property Acknowledgement Receipt
items.details: Property items fifty thousand pesos (P50,000.00) and above with pictures. Please indicate serial numbers and date acquired.

items.label: Pictures
items.details: Pictures of items procured

title: Liquidation of Cash Advance for Petroleum Oil and Lubricants - Direct Retail
description: Mode of procurement must be made from any available retailers, dealers or gas stations at retail pump price; The requirement must be intended to be used for any official government vehicles and equipment for immediate consumption; and Payment may be made through cash advance, reimbursement or other allowable payment modalities subject to pertinent auditing and accounting rules and regulations.

items.label: Annual Procurement Plan
items.details: Approved annual procurement plan. Proposal for additional PPMPs or changes to the PPMPs may be undertaken as often as necessary. The End-User or Implementing Units of the Procuring Entity shall be responsible for the preparation of the new or revised PPMPs, while the BAC Secretariat shall incorporate the approved PPMPs into the APP, to be recommended by the BAC for approval of the HoPE. (Section 7.9)
